## Problem

What is wrong, missing or stale in the showcase today, and how you know.

## Desired Outcome

What the showcase says once this is done.

## Scope

The pages and claims this ticket authorizes changing.

## Out of Scope

What it does not authorize, even if it looks related.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every changed claim is checked against the running system and its status label is correct.
- [ ] The evidence index changes in the same pull request as the claim it supports.
- [ ] The disclosure check in CONTRIBUTING.md is done for every commit on the branch.

## Verification

How a reviewer confirms each criterion.

## Dependencies / Blockers

Anything that must happen first, or "None".

## Risks / Constraints

What could be disclosed or misstated, and how the change is rolled back.
